messages:
maria_cs: Quick sync — terraforge edge private deploy. Ops team flagged telemetry ingestion gap: splunk forwarder not yet approved by customer egress rules. Also need KMS key usage pattern clarified for short-lived keys vs customer-managed rotation. Any blockers for week0 go/no-go?

leo_infra: Re: egress — customer network team asked for specific destination IPs and ports. We sent them list but they want CIDR ranges. Can we provide a deterministic egress CIDR set for the edge nodes?

ash_serving: We should be able to give a stable set: 10.42.0.0/24 (internal), plus outbound NAT to our shared egress pool 34.85.12.0/26. I'll confirm with infra.

devon_security: KMS question: are we using Redwood-managed CMK or customer-provided key (BYOK)? If BYOK, what's the policy for rotation and who rotates? Also need to confirm audit log retention (customer asked 2y but their compliance may require 7y).

maria_cs: Customer requested BYOK for data-at-rest. They want to rotate keys quarterly. They also flagged retention should be configurable but default to 2y. They're asking for a migration plan if they later need longer retention.

leo_infra: Noted. For BYOK we need the following in their KMS policy: principal for redwood-inference-service, Encrypt/Decrypt, GenerateDataKey, DescribeKey. Devon — is the short policy below acceptable?

leo_infra: ```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-inference"},"Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey","kms:DescribeKey"],"Resource":"*"}
  ]
}
```

devon_security: That looks ok as a starting point but we need the customer to limit Resource and include a Condition for aws:PrincipalTag/Environment if they tag roles per environment. Also add kms:ReEncrypt for rotation flows.

ash_serving: Thanks — I'll update docs and push snippet to the onboarding playbook.

maria_cs: On telemetry: customer ops said splunk HECTCP to splunk.example.net:8088 is blocked. They asked if we can buffer locally and forward later, or if we can switch to HTTPS ingestion to their collector. Which is less friction?

leo_infra: HTTPS to their collector is easiest if they can expose it. Buffering is possible but we need disk sizing for retention — it's more operationally risky during cutover.

devon_security: Also confirm that audit logs include KMS key usage details. If they need 7y retention we should propose lifecycle: hot -> warm -> cold export to their S3 with lifecycle policy. That reduces renewal risk.

maria_cs: Good idea. Customer is worried about renewal if week0 telemetry gaps persist. Action items: 1) ash to send finalized egress CIDRs by EOD. 2) leo to propose BYOK policy update with kms:ReEncrypt and Condition. 3) devon to draft retention migration runbook (2y default, export path to S3 for longer). 4) I'll coordinate with customer PM and set follow-up call Thu 10am PT.

ash_serving: Working on CIDRs now, will ping once I have confirmation from net team.

leo_infra: Drafted policy updated and pushing to playbook branch: refs/edge-onboard/byok-policy-v2.

ops-bot: dry-run deployment for terraforge-edge completed: 2/3 checks passed, telemetry-forwarder health = FAIL, reason: egress blocked. Next run scheduled in 30m.

maria_cs: Thanks all — if we can get the collector endpoint or allow our egress pool the customer should be green. I'll capture these action items in the ticket and include the renewal sensitivity note. :thumbsup:
